svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · MULTI-TENANT RDMA ISOLATION & DPU OFFLOAD (#374)
BlueField-3 DPU (DOCA VPC) vs. Multus SR-IOV vs. IB P_Key / RoCEv2 QoS
Hardware-Paced Per-VF Congestion Isolation & DPU Offload Prevent Noisy-Neighbor PFC Pause Storm Contagion (<0.8% Jitter)
Tier 1 & 2 Risk: Cross-Tenant PFC Storm Contagion
• Tenant A runs MoE AlltoAll incast or hits a degraded slow-NIC
• Continuous Priority-3 PFC Pause frames backpressure ToR buffers
• Head-of-Line blocking spreads across shared switch buffer pools
• Victim Tenant B AllReduce Busbw Collapses by 28.5% to 62.0%!
Tier 4: BlueField-3 DPU + Hardware Per-VF CC
• DPU ASIC offloads EVPN-VXLAN & zero-trust ACLs (0 Host CPUs)
• Per-VF hardware RTT congestion pacing throttles only the sender
• ToR Switch Dynamic Alpha Buffer + 200ms PFC Watchdog
• 388 Gbps (97% Line Rate) & <0.8% Cross-Tenant Busbw Jitter
4-Tier Multi-Tenant RDMA Isolation Matrix (1,024 GPUs · 400G Fabric · 12 Tenants)
Tier 1 (Shared hostNetwork: true) : Busbw = 340 Gbps | Victim Drop = 62.0% | Host CPUs = 18 | Zero-Trust = No
Tier 2 (Multus CNI + SR-IOV VLAN) : Busbw = 365 Gbps | Victim Drop = 28.5% | Host CPUs = 8 | Zero-Trust = No
Tier 3 (SR-IOV + P_Key/Per-VF QoS) : Busbw = 376 Gbps | Victim Drop = 4.2% | Host CPUs = 4 | Zero-Trust = No
Tier 4 (BlueField-3 DPU + RTT CC) : Busbw = 388 Gbps | Victim Drop = 0.8% | Host CPUs = 0 | Zero-Trust = Yes
